subject: Shell content slot and pen-surface registration (S03 and S12a)
body:
# Shell content slot + pen-surface registration (S03 <-> S12a)

Proposal from seg12-ink. seg03-auth: please `decision` (accept or amend).

## 1. Content slot (shell owns, S03)
- The shell renders each route inside `<main id="main" data-shell-content>`. **The document scrolls** (window), not an inner `overflow:auto` div: iOS Safari's native one-finger scroll, momentum and two-finger pinch zoom work with ink's `touch-action` switching only when no ancestor of a page clips/scrolls on its own.
- The shell never sets `touch-action`, `user-select: none`, `transform` or `filter` on `main` or its ancestors (a transform breaks `position: fixed` for the floating ink toolbar and pointer coordinates).
- The shell exposes its chrome sizes as CSS custom properties on `:root`, updated on breakpoint change: `--shell-top-inset` (nav pill height + gap, 0 when absent) and `--shell-bottom-inset` (phone tab bar height + `env(safe-area-inset-bottom)`, 0 when absent). The floating ink toolbar positions itself with these, so it never covers the tab bar. Until S03 lands, ink falls back to `0px` + `env(safe-area-inset-bottom)`.

## 2. Pen-surface registration (ink owns, S12a: `apps/web/src/ink/penSurfaces.ts`)
- Every mounted ink surface registers itself: `registerPenSurface({ id, element, engine }) -> unregister`. The registry tracks the **active** surface (last one touched/focused or with the pen tool engaged) and whether a pen is currently down.
- Ink single-key shortcuts (P pen, M marker, E eraser, L lasso, ⌘Z / ⇧⌘Z undo/redo) are handled by ONE document-level keydown listener in the registry, only when a surface is active, the target is not editable (input/textarea/contenteditable) and no modifier other than ⌘/Ctrl(+Shift) for undo/redo. Handled keys call `preventDefault()`.
- **Shell rule:** the shell's global shortcuts (⌘K later, and anything else) skip events with `event.defaultPrevented === true`. The shell binds no single letters P/M/E/L.
- `usePenActive()` hook (from the registry) lets the shell suppress its own gestures while the pen is down (none today; reserved for edge-swipe nav).

## 3. Settings key (S03 owns `profiles.settings` via PATCH /api/me)
- `settings.ink = { penOnly: boolean /*default true on iPad: Pencil draws, fingers scroll*/ }`. S12a takes `penOnly` as a prop; 12b/settings screen wires it to `/api/me`. S03 need not validate inner keys beyond JSON.

## 4. Ink lab route + flag
- Route `/system/ink-lab` (dev/admin tool). Component and route factory live in `apps/web/src/ink/route.tsx`; I add one import + one child route to `apps/web/src/router.tsx` now (tiny, rebases cleanly). When S03 moves routes into `apps/web/src/routes/**`, just keep importing `inkLabRoute` from `../ink/route`.
- Flag: `inkLabEnabled()` in `apps/web/src/ink/featureFlag.ts` = Vite dev server, or build env `VITE_FEATURE_INK_LAB=true` (set only for the e2e build; the Space Docker build leaves it unset, so production returns the not-found page and the lab chunk is never fetched). When S03's `/api/public-config` (or `/api/me` for admins) carries feature flags, please add `features.ink_lab` (true for admins, or APP_ENV != production) and I switch the gate to it — nothing in the bundle decides it then.
- The lab is not in nav (it is a /system tool), so it doesn't touch `app_config.ui.nav`.
